job: Collect today's water sample from the pump house: the bottle is on the sample shelf inside, past the kerb at the door. Bring it out to the gate.
understood_as: Pick up today's water sample bottle from the sample shelf in the pump room, crossing the kerb at the door, and carry it out of the pump house to the gate.
steps: Go into the pump house, over the kerb at the door.
Pick up the water sample bottle from the sample shelf.
Carry the bottle back over the kerb and out of the pump house.

demos.why: Shows how a hand reaches the bottle on the sample shelf and lifts it clear without knocking anything over.
Shows how firmly to hold the bottle so it does not slip or get squeezed and spill while being carried over the kerb.

questions: How high is the kerb at the pump house door? The robot has to cross it twice, once each way, so we need the height to design for it.
The robot can bring the bottle as far as the pump house door but cannot yet be sent to the gate. Is leaving it just outside the door all right, or will someone take it from there to the gate?
unmet: Delivering the bottle to the gate: the planner can only take it out of the building to the way out, not on to a specific spot such as the gate.
